adaptation: New files only. Original upstream worktree files retained; CRLF working copies verified against canonical committed LF bytes.

source.isolation: Reuse already frozen all-target decoded-pixel and available-ID isolation; no target references for learning or retrieval.

deployment_adaptation.dicom: Executor binds native dicom_path rather than image_path; original failed source preflight preserved.
deployment_adaptation.probe: Seven tools tested on isolated original source image; DICOM tested on clearly marked synthetic DICOM fixture from source pixels. No paid API calls for local tool probes.
deployment_adaptation.gpu: Physical GPU0, same environment for both new arms.
deployment_adaptation.old_runs: Read-only reuse; new output/code namespace; no old failed cache/calls/selections copied.
